property_summary: The reference contract only allows airdrops to callers whose msg.sender supports the Nu Token according to Bank(sender).supportsToken(), ensuring tokenBalance[msg.sender] is updated only for matching supporters; the buggy version drops this check, allowing a mismatched caller to receive tokens and violating the invariant that no airdrop updates balance when the caller's Bank does not support the token.
change_summary: Remove the supportsToken modifier, allowing calls from contracts that do not support Nu Token.
